$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-i18n.mjs. Only narrow, intentional exceptions belong here. Every entry must be justified: data-source names, Chinese brand names, or source news titles that may legitimately appear inside English UI strings. Do NOT add general Chinese words here to silence real residue — translate the string instead.

$notes.allowedCjkSubstrings: Substrings removed from an en.json value before the Chinese-residue check runs. Use for proper nouns only (e.g. the Chinese site name or data-source brands).
$notes.allowedCjkKeys: Exact flat keys for which the English value may legitimately stay Chinese: brand.name (the 照胆云 brand mark shown in the logo lockup) and ui.lang.zh (language switcher option, shown in the target language's own script).
$notes.manualDynamicPrefixes: Fallback dynamic key prefixes (e.g. "board.") for cases where the i18n key is assembled at runtime in a way the static scanner cannot infer. Prefer literal keys or explicit mapping constants in JS; use this only as a last resort.
$notes.ignoredUnusedKeys: Keys intentionally kept in the dictionaries although nothing references them statically (e.g. keys consumed by an external build tool). Prefer deleting stale keys.
